tools.name: source_code_context
tools.title: Find code for a task
tools.description:
Return the symbols worth reading before making a specific change. Describe the change in your own words.

- `task` is prose: "where do we invalidate the cache after a write" works better than a bare identifier.
- A router classifies the task as identifier-shaped or prose-shaped and reports which, and why.
- Results fuse a lexical match against symbol names, paths and doc comments with the graph ranking. Only symbols that actually matched participate, so an unrelated task returns nothing rather than the repository's busiest utility.
- `confidence` is derived from how far the top result separates from the rest. It is a measure of separation, never a claim of correctness, and a single result is always low.
- Counts are FLOORS: edges are recovered from source text by name, so dynamic dispatch, callbacks, trait objects and macro-generated calls contribute none.
- The graph stops at a directory that is its own repository and at files the repository's .gitignore excludes; pass a nested repository as `path` to search it.

task.description: The change you are about to make, in your own words.

path.description: Root-relative subdirectory to scope the graph to. Absent means the whole configured root, and an empty string is the same as absent.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Narrows the result; it can never widen it past the host ceiling.

shape.description: How the router read the task: `nameExact` or `conceptual`.

shapeReason.description: Why it read it that way, in one sentence.

confidence.description: `high`, `medium`, or `low`, derived from score separation. Never a claim of correctness.

marginPercent.description: How far the top score sits above the head's median, as a percentage.

totalMatched.description: Symbols with any lexical match. Not every one is returned.

rank.description: Personalized PageRank score. Comparable within one result, meaningless across two.

callers.description: Distinct symbols referencing this one. A floor.

calls.description: Distinct symbols this one references. A floor.

testScope.description: Whether the definition sits in test scope.

resolvedReferences.description: References that resolved to a definition.

unresolvedReferences.description: References naming something the map never defined. Usually a call into a dependency.

ambiguousReferences.description: References matching more than one definition, whose weight was split rather than guessed.

declinedReferences.description:
Calls whose receiver or qualifier points outside the tree, so they were never linked to the
in-tree symbol that happens to share their name.

prConverged.description:
Whether the iteration reached its residual tolerance.

A truncated run produces a document that looks identical to a converged one and does not
mean the same thing: it is a rank vector caught mid-descent.

truncatedBy.description: Bounds that stopped the crawl, extraction, or ranking, by name. Empty means none did.

scanComplete.description: Whether the traversal examined every candidate it produced.

filesIgnored.description: Files the tree's own `.gitignore` rules kept out of the map.

prunedRepositories.description:
Directories not mapped because they are separate repositories.

A vendored repository's symbols would compete with this project's in one rank vector, so the
map stops at the boundary. Naming one as `path` maps it on its own terms.

GraphSummary.description:
What the graph run itself had to say.

Present on every result. A ranking produced from a truncated crawl and one produced from a
complete crawl are different claims, and nothing downstream can tell them apart without this.

tools.name: source_code_refs
tools.title: List callers, call sites and reach
tools.description:
List what calls a symbol and from which lines, or what it calls. With `depth`, show what a change to it could reach and which tests already cover it. Use it instead of grep for a symbol's callers and call sites.

- `direction` is `callers` (default) or `callees`. Callers come most important first; callees in the order the body calls them.
- Each direct row lists its call sites as `at=` lines, so one call finds every place a change must touch.
- `depth` walks callers further back (default 1, host-capped). Rows report their hop, nearest first, with a count per hop and how many of them are tests.
- `symbol` may be a bare name or `path::name` to disambiguate. A name matching several definitions returns their union and says so, rather than silently picking one.
- An unknown symbol is REFUSED with did-you-mean candidates, not answered with zero. A symbol that exists and has no callers returns zero.
- Counts are FLOORS: dynamic dispatch, callbacks, trait objects and macro-generated calls contribute no edge, so 0 means none was found, never that none exists. A call whose receiver or path names a type outside the tree is never linked by name, and a link made by name alone is marked.

symbol.description: A symbol name, optionally qualified as `path::name` to disambiguate.

direction.description: `callers` lists symbols referencing this one; `callees` lists the ones it references.

depth.description: Hops to walk back along call edges, callers only. Above 1 the result is what a change could reach. Beyond a few hops a reachability set describes the repository rather than a blast radius.

path.description: Root-relative subdirectory to scope the graph to. Absent means the whole configured root, and an empty string is the same as absent.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Narrows the result; it can never widen it past the host ceiling.

unit.description: What one row counts, named for the direction.

depth.description: Hops walked. One is the direct neighbourhood.

matched.description: Definitions the selector matched. More than one means the answer is a union.

references.description: Nearest first; within one hop, callers by rank and callees in source order.

byDepth.description: Rows found at each hop, from hop one. Present when more than one hop was walked.

testsReaching.description:
Rows sitting in test scope: the existing coverage of a change. Present when more than one
hop was walked.

declined.description:
Calls spelling the selected name that were not linked to it, because their receiver or
qualifier points at a type outside the tree.

refused.description: Always true, so a consumer can branch without inspecting the shape.

didYouMean.description: Nearest known symbol names, by edit distance. Empty when nothing is close.

oneOf.description:
A selector that named nothing.

Distinct from an empty result on purpose. `source_code_refs` on a symbol with no callers is the answer
`0`; `source_code_refs` on a misspelled symbol is not an answer at all, and returning `0` for it would
let a caller conclude something false about code that exists.
oneOf.title: SelectorRefusal

SymbolRef.description: A symbol named without a rank, used where ordering comes from something else.

rank.description: Personalized PageRank score. Comparable within one result, meaningless across two.

callers.description: Distinct symbols referencing this one. A floor.

calls.description: Distinct symbols this one references. A floor.

testScope.description: Whether the definition sits in test scope.

hops.description: Edges walked from the selected symbol. One means a direct caller or callee.

sites.description: The call sites between this row and the selected symbol, in source order. Direct rows only.

sitesTotal.description: Every call site, when `sites` was capped.

nameOnly.description:
Linked by name alone: the receiver's type was never seen, so the call may mean another
symbol with the same name. Such a link never moves a ranking.

ReferenceRow.description: One symbol reached from the selected one, with where the calls are.

SiteRef.description: One line of source where a reference was made.

resolvedReferences.description: References that resolved to a definition.
